traits.name: Freeze
traits.text:
If the elemental water dragon takes cold damage, it partially
freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The dragon’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: create or destroy water * 3/day: control water * 1/day each: control weather, plane shift

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can
choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text:
The dragon deals double damage to objects and
structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The dragon can make three attacks: one with its bite and
two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18
(2d10 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14
(2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16
(2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The dragon exhales a 60-foot cone of
superheated steam that spreads around corners. Creatures within the area
must make DC 19 Dexterity saving throws, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage
on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one. Being
underwater does not provide resistance to this effect.
